properties.name: LT127
properties.description: LT: Remains of a very extensive settlement, covering several hectares east of the track up to about 300m west of the marabout. Scattered traces of walls in the northern part of the site on the summit: to the south, stones from a looted necropolis, burials under jars and under tiles; to the south-east, a small sundial in fine limestone from Dar Chaabane. On a small tell of vault tubes, fragments of tile, a collapsed vault, indicate the presence of thermal baths: pilette bricks of hypocausts and calcined lava blocks from the hearth.
properties.label: EAMENA-0207228
